author: king process
description:
A Korean Man Pours a Blue Ocean into Dead Wood?! An Amazing Table Brought to Life with Resin

Hello, this is King Process.
Today, we introduce three pieces created by a Korean man who has spent over 30 years working with rare woods from around the world.
A resin table with a blue ocean poured into dead wood, a table made with beautiful flowers preserved inside, and a resin staircase with light that appears to flow across the steps.
He does not hide the cracks or natural grain of the wood. Instead, he preserves its original character and pours resin into it. In his hands, old wood is reborn as a one-of-a-kind work of art.
Please sit back and enjoy his careful craftsmanship and the way he makes use of every part of the wood.

1. The Man Who Brings Dead Wood to Life?! A Korean Resin Table That Captures the Entire Ocean

2. The Man Who Makes Tables with Real Flowers?! A Korean Resin Table Where Emotion Meets Technique
